nodes.title: Govern autonomous R&D as a controlled epistemic process, not a single agent trying hard
Advance the epistemic frontier by retiring uncertainty rather than authoring longer plans
Materialize a Geolog/Datalog-style change-governance substrate as a runnable POC
End-to-end planning works only in a minority of cases with stable goals and known terrain
A governance substrate's distinctive value is governing dynamic change, not storing static artifacts
The right target is warranted action, not correct action
Context isolation between roles prevents narrative momentum and self-assessment bias
Epistemic frontier

detail.definition: The boundary between the current epistemic state and the area where further work is not yet planable; progress consists of pushing it back by retiring uncertainty.

nodes.title: Warranted action

detail.definition: An action whose local neighborhood has the required shape — cited intent, capability, evidence, review — regardless of whether it ultimately turns out to be a good idea.

nodes.title: Tile-edge

detail.definition: A required local match condition on a fact: a tile snaps into the picture only if its edges find matching neighbor-edges, mirroring a geometric-logic sequent.

nodes.title: Belief funnel

detail.definition: The governed progression hypothesised to predicted to witnessed to corroborated to claimed to settled, parallel to the action funnel, with admissibility rules at each promotion.

nodes.title: Contention

detail.definition: A first-class fact linking two contradicting claims so disagreement is admitted as structure rather than suppressed by a quiet overwrite.

nodes.title: Mandate

detail.definition: The human-authored, run-immutable commander's-intent declaring end-state, standing orders, escalation rules, and energy budget.

nodes.title: Sensemaker

detail.definition: A proposed context-isolated role whose only write-authority is the situation/belief tables; it maintains the picture and never authors actions.

nodes.title: rd-loop is a working bash harness invoking Amp in execute mode against persistent disk state
The concept assumes familiarity with Kleppmann's Geolog geometric-logic rationale
Human organizational models (ICS, trauma teams, CIC/bridge) encode bounded autonomy under uncertainty
The executor registers falsifiable predictions before each iteration; the gate audits whether they held
A proposed action must cite an active intent whose scope covers its objective
An execution claim must cite an active capability covering action kind, resource, and phase
A completion claim must be validated by a role distinct from the one that produced the artifact
Every tool with a path-like argument must be gated independently within the turn
SQLite plus a hand-rolled axiom evaluator in Bun suffices as a less-efficient mimic for the POC
Folding action and picture-maintenance into one executor is acceptable for small research loops
mandate.md is human-authored and immutable during a run
The adversary never sees the executor's chain of thought, only artifacts and ledger entries
An energy budget bounds autonomy; exhaustion forces a mandatory halt
Constraint-checking and proof-checking are the same operation; every admitted fact carries a well-formedness proof
A settled claim cannot be quietly overwritten; contradiction is admitted as a contention object
Moving phase creates a new epoch; old capabilities do not automatically match the new epoch
Failures are first-class facts, as citeable as successes
Govern via warranted-action admissibility rather than modeling the plan as the load-bearing object

detail.chosen_option: Encode admissibility axioms over warranted local neighborhoods that decide which writes become facts
rejected: Model the plan as the load-bearing governing object
Store specs and plans in the substrate as a rich document store
detail.rationale: A plan is advisory and an agent can ignore it; admissibility is constitutive, so an unwarranted write never becomes a fact.

nodes.title: Separate the three agent roles by context window

detail.chosen_option: Run executor, gate, and adversary as separate Amp instances with isolated context windows
rejected: A single agent that both does the work and judges it
detail.rationale: Isolation prevents narrative momentum and self-assessment bias; the adversary judges artifacts, not the executor's reasoning.

nodes.title: Dissolve the Gate into the substrate and add a Sensemaker role

detail.chosen_option: Let write-time substrate admissibility absorb the Gate's checklist and add a Sensemaker owning situation/belief writes
rejected: Keep the Gate as a post-hoc agent
Leave belief-picture maintenance inside the executor
detail.rationale: The judge becomes the schema; separating the doer from the picture-maintainer dissolves the narrative-momentum problem.

The capability axiom realizes the cite-a-capability requirement.
The executor settings.json realizes per-tool path gating.
driver.sh realizes prediction registration and audit across the five phases.
The six-table store plus axiom evaluator realizes constraint-checking-as-proof.
The Sensemaker's contention writes realize the no-quiet-overwrite invariant.
The energy-budget constraint bounds autonomous pursuit of the governance goal.
The immutable-mandate constraint bounds what the executor may modify.
The geometric-fragment governance decision bounds the substrate POC's logic.
The seed-crystal POC contains the file-to-fact-protocol frontier.
The seed-crystal POC contains the role-differentiation frontier.

The fact-protocol frontier contains the fact-schema spike slice.

The ICS/trauma-team analogy and the Sensemaker role are peer expressions of staff differentiation.
Warranted-action and govern-change are peer pillars of the same reframe.
The role-dissolution decision supersedes the single-executor assumption as the system scales.

The stale-reference rejection criterion witnesses the phase-epoch invariant.
